interpretation: M2.69 adds a narrow text profile that rescues txt_003/WKU, the final low-adaptive-precision sample left after M2.68. It improves text adaptive precision without increasing jump, trim, visible connector, or off-mask risk.
professional_digitizing_relevance: adds low-precision text as a separate production failure mode
uses a conservative profile gate instead of globally changing all rendered text
removes the last adaptive precision failure from the public benchmark
preserves execution safety while improving text boundary cleanliness
tradeoff: M2.69 slightly lowers mean strict precision and coverage because the WKU candidate is marginally more inset, but the adaptive precision and adaptive coverage improve and no execution-risk metric gets worse.
remaining_bottlenecks: qd_002/dog remains the worst high-jump line-art sample
QuickDraw strict precision remains weak on several sparse line drawings
professional realism still requires explicit satin/fill/running texture and stitch-type layering beyond current command-level metrics

next_recommended_stage.reason: After M2.69, adaptive precision no longer has failing samples; the most important remaining measurable issue is qd_002 high_jump_excess.
